title: Daily Activity Baseline and Deviation
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eldercare:activity
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(motion_events) as motion by _time
| eventstats avg(motion) as baseline, stdev(motion) as sd
| eval low=if(motion<baseline-2*sd,1,0)
| where low=1
description: Learns a loved one's normal daily movement around the home and flags days that fall well below it, which can signal illness or a problem.
value: A quiet house is often the first sign something is wrong for someone living alone; catching it early can prevent harm.
implementation: Ingest motion-sensor counts into `index=personal`; compare each day to a rolling baseline and alert on big drops.
visualization: Line chart of daily motion with a baseline band and flagged low days.
grandmaExplanation: It learns how much your relative normally moves about at home and warns you on days they are unusually still.
